## Lift Curves by Model

```{r}
ggplot(lift, aes(x = risk_decile, y = actual_loss_cost, color = model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.1) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Actual Loss Cost by Predicted Risk Decile")
```
